evals.prompt: Tolong koordinasikan implementasi fitur multi-tenant checkout di sistem Next.js + PostgreSQL ini.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator triages decisions, sequences Wave 1 (architect + data schema), Wave 2 (frontend + craft visual lead), Wave 3 (verify + slopscan gate), and produces execution plan.

evals.prompt: Halaman dashboard admin ini tampilannya jelek banget kayak template AI, tolong benerin dong.
evals.expected_output: Routes immediately to maxilun-craft with companion maxilun-verify; instructs craft to measure before rebuilding; bans emoji and floating pills.
assertions: rejects cosmetic patch over locked shell

evals.prompt: Kita harus pecah monolit ini ke microservices sekarang juga atau tetap monolit modular?
evals.expected_output: Classifies as Type 1 irreversible decision; asks at most one grouped turn with 2-3 contrasting options, trade-offs, and one firm recommendation; defaults to modular monolith baseline.

evals.prompt: Knowledge graph sudah ada. Tambahkan fitur export CSV di tabel pesanan (tombol di UI + endpoint API).
evals.expected_output: Locates the orders list code once via locate; sizes the work as cross-domain; cuts two units with disjoint write sets (craft UI, engineer endpoint); sends handoff packets containing the Read plan and a done gate; verifies before reporting.
assertions: runs locate instead of reading files one by one
handoff packet includes READ PLAN and DONE GATE
accepts results only with done-gate output

evals.prompt: Perbaiki typo label 'Simpn' jadi 'Simpan' di tombol form profil.
evals.expected_output: Sizes as Direct; one owner edits inline with no subagent fan-out and no wave; still verifies.

evals.prompt: /maxilun council lalu: ganti layout halaman checkout jadi dua kolom.
evals.expected_output: Runs council_hook.py --on, executes Phase 0 Knowledge Graph locate/query before Round 1 so every speaker receives verified file:line structure/code context, holds a meeting where each speaker critiques trade-offs and answers earlier ones by @name, ends with a synthesis and the ACC question, and edits no file in that turn.
assertions: runs knowledge graph locate/query before starting the council meeting
shares KG file:line context with meeting speakers
speakers reply to each other by @name
at least one OBJECT with file:line or [UNVERIFIED]
labels minutes [simulated] when no subagent tool exists
creates or edits no file before ACC
ends the turn with the ACC question

evals.prompt: (council aktif) lanjut diskusi soal warna dulu ya
evals.expected_output: Treats the message as more deliberation, not approval; continues the meeting and still edits nothing.
assertions: does not treat "lanjut diskusi" as ACC
continues the meeting on the colour question

evals.prompt: Belum ada knowledge graph di repo ini. Cari di mana validasi NIK di-handle lalu perbaiki bug-nya.
evals.expected_output: Builds the graph once with kg_scan or cli.py scan, then locates the validation with kg_locate before any Grep or file read, and reads only the returned ranges.
assertions: first discovery call is the knowledge graph
builds the graph with scan when none exists
no Grep/Glob before the graph call
proves the fix with a failing-then-passing test
